title: Turnaround, Peak Season and Rush Availability — Marlowe & Finch Alterations Service Classes
content:
The workroom standards for Marlowe & Finch Alterations fix, for each service class, how many business days the work takes, when peak season adds days, whether the work goes to the specialty partner workshop, and whether rush service can be bought.

## Standard turnaround

| Service class | Business days to ready under standard service | Peak-season months | Business days added in peak season | Sent to specialty partner workshop | Business days added for outsourced work |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Hem & Cuff | 2 | April, May, June (months 4, 5, 6) | 0 | no | 0 |
| Standard Alterations | 5 | April, May, June (months 4, 5, 6) | 2 | no | 0 |
| Tailored Suiting | 7 | April, May, June, November, December (months 4, 5, 6, 11, 12) | 2 | no | 0 |
| Formal & Evening Wear | 10 | April, May, June, November, December (months 4, 5, 6, 11, 12) | 5 | no | 0 |
| Bridal Alterations | 21 | April, May, June (months 4, 5, 6) | 7 | no | 0 |
| Leather & Specialty | 14 | November, December (months 11, 12) | 3 | yes | 5 |

The standard turnaround counts business days from drop-off (or from the last fitting) to ready.

## Rush service

| Service class | Rush service can be bought | Business days to ready under rush | Rush fee, percent of the ticket's operation charges | Rush depends on shop capacity on the drop-off date | A Finch Circle tier's waived-rush-fee benefit waives this class's rush fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Hem & Cuff | no | not applicable | not applicable | yes | not applicable |
| Standard Alterations | yes | 2 | 50 | yes | yes |
| Tailored Suiting | yes | 3 | 50 | yes | yes |
| Formal & Evening Wear | yes | 4 | 50 | yes | yes |
| Bridal Alterations | yes | 7 | 25 | yes | yes |
| Leather & Specialty | no | not applicable | not applicable | yes | not applicable |

## Points of reading

- Peak-season days are added only for a drop-off in one of the class's listed months; Express Hem & Cuff lists peak months but adds 0 days.
- Only Leather & Specialty sends work to the partner workshop, and only that class carries outsourced days (5).
- Rush is never sold in Express Hem & Cuff or Leather & Specialty; in every class that sells it, availability also depends on the shop's capacity on the day.
- Hypothetical comparison: in Bridal Alterations rush shortens 21 business days to 7; in Standard Alterations it shortens 5 business days to 2.
